_doc: Fun-metric limits and baseline for run_bot_test.py --fun-check (see fun_report.py). Medians from the 8-bot, 180 s WebSocket run on 2026-11-23 (four runs: first reward 7.4-8.5 s, rewards/min 4.2-6.2, wait 0.01 s). longest_dead_s is reported but not compared: today it is mostly bots wandering after their one gather per login (41-69 s median across runs).
